frozen_before: first generation on these articles; do not edit after the run
scoring: per checkpoint: covered_faithful | covered_partial | missing | flagged_by_diagnostic (reported separately)

checkpoints.article_quote: Women in the group with the highest PFOA levels had a 67% higher rate of ER-negative breast cancer than those in the lowest group.
checkpoints.must_keep: PFOA; 67% higher rate; ER-negative breast cancer specifically; comparison is highest vs lowest PFOA group

checkpoints.article_quote: For PFOS, the rate was 93% higher, or nearly twice as high.
checkpoints.must_keep: PFOS; 93% higher rate (nearly twice as high); ER-negative rate and highest-vs-lowest baseline carried from previous sentence

checkpoints.article_quote: For the PFAS study, researchers included 1,609 women who developed breast cancer and a comparison sample of 2,269 women.
checkpoints.must_keep: 1,609 women who developed breast cancer vs comparison sample of 2,269 women (drawn from Sister Study); both counts exact

checkpoints.article_quote: No clear association was observed between the two chemicals and breast cancer risk overall.
checkpoints.must_keep: negation is 'no clear association' (not 'no association' / not 'no risk'); scope is breast cancer overall, for PFOA and PFOS

checkpoints.article_quote: These numbers describe relative differences between groups, not an individual woman’s chance of getting breast cancer.
checkpoints.must_keep: percentages are relative differences between groups, not absolute/individual probability

checkpoints.article_quote: the authors suggest that PFAS may affect cancer risk through other non-hormonal biologic pathways
checkpoints.must_keep: hedged mechanism: 'authors suggest' + 'may'; must not become a finding that PFAS cause cancer via these pathways (next sentences: study did not test them)

checkpoints.article_quote: “This NIH study links two forever chemicals to a higher risk of ER-negative breast cancer and demands further investigation.
checkpoints.must_keep: speaker is HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. (official statement), not the study authors; 'links'/'higher risk' is his wording; ER-negative scope; 'demands further investigation'

checkpoints.article_quote: The share of first-time homebuyers remains at a near-record low of 22%
checkpoints.must_keep: 22% share of first-time homebuyers; 'near-record low' (not record); per National Association of Realtors report

checkpoints.article_quote: 1 in 10 paid all cash, a record high since such data was collected starting in 2003
checkpoints.must_keep: 1 in 10 (of first-time buyers); all cash; record high; data collected since 2003

checkpoints.article_quote: For first-time buyers who financed a purchase it was 38, while for those who paid all-cash it was 54.
checkpoints.must_keep: median age of first-time buyers: financed 38 vs all-cash 54 (overall median 40 in previous sentence); 'median' and first-time-buyer scope

checkpoints.article_quote: First-time buyers who paid all-cash were more likely than those who financed a house to use an inheritance (28%) or proceeds from the sale of an inherited property (21%).
checkpoints.must_keep: 28% inheritance and 21% sale of inherited property apply to all-cash first-time buyers; comparative 'more likely than financed buyers'; not overall share of all buyers

checkpoints.article_quote: The share of first time buyers using an inheritance is likely to grow in coming years as boomers reach their 80's and beyond.
checkpoints.must_keep: forecast hedge 'is likely to grow' (not 'will'); first-time buyers using inheritance; reason: boomers reaching 80s and beyond

checkpoints.article_quote: But in another shift, more people used assets – like a 401(k), stocks, or cryptocurrency – than financial help from family or friends.
checkpoints.must_keep: comparison: more first-time buyers used assets (401(k), stocks, crypto) than help from family/friends for down payment; personal savings remained biggest source overall

checkpoints.article_quote: "I would say in the first 15 years of my career, I saw virtually zero first-time home buyers paying all cash," said Jason Miller, a broker with Trust Real Estate Company in St. Cloud, Minn.
checkpoints.must_keep: speaker Jason Miller, broker in St. Cloud, Minn.; personal anecdotal observation ('I would say', first 15 years of his career), not a national statistic

checkpoints.article_quote: Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Tuesday sought to assure Americans that there's "zero" information that the cascade of service outages
checkpoints.must_keep: Rubio (Secretary of State), on Tuesday; 'sought to assure' / 'zero' information is his assertion; outages related to each other or to a malign actor

checkpoints.article_quote: Flights across the country were grounded the next day in the longest so-called ground stop since 9/11.
checkpoints.must_keep: flights grounded the day after Thursday's Microsoft outage; longest ground stop since 9/11; 'so-called'

checkpoints.article_quote: an internal network that the National Security Agency uses to communicate classified information was offline after what the agency described as "routine maintenance."
checkpoints.must_keep: NSA internal classified-communications network offline on Tuesday; 'routine maintenance' is the agency's own description

checkpoints.article_quote: She did not present any evidence of an attack.
checkpoints.must_keep: Laura Loomer's 'coordinated cyberattack' claim (on X) was unsupported: no evidence presented; claim must stay attributed/disputed, not stated as fact

checkpoints.article_quote: the U.S. government believes the incidents were caused by security upgrades that took longer than planned or encountered unexpected hiccups
checkpoints.must_keep: hedge 'believes'; DNI Jay Clayton explaining; cause is the government's belief, not established fact; 'not seeing this as a cyberattack'

checkpoints.article_quote: even staunch Trump allies have accused the administration of lying to Americans or hiding information about the true cause
checkpoints.must_keep: 'accused' (allegation, not established); made by Trump allies about the administration; lying or hiding information about the cause

checkpoints.article_quote: "It's life. When you're big and powerful and you have all the money, things like that happen. It's fine," Trump said in Manila
checkpoints.must_keep: speaker Donald Trump, in Manila, Tuesday, responding to a question about the Chase outage; exact stance 'It's fine'
